post.description:
Called by frontend immediately after successful OAuth.
Creates a users row if it doesn't exist.
Returns whether onboarding is required.

Expected flow:
1. Frontend completes OAuth with Supabase JS SDK
2. Frontend calls POST /auth/sync-user with Authorization header
3. Backend creates users row (id, email)
4. Backend returns { requires_onboarding: bool }
5. Frontend routes to onboarding if required, else to dashboard

Requires: Authorization header with Supabase session token

patch.description:
Update user with onboarding data.
Called when user completes the 4-screen onboarding stepper.

Requires: Authorization header with Supabase session token

get.description:
Get current user profile.

Requires: Authorization header with Supabase session token

post.description:
Upload a document for a dog.
Immediately returns document_id and storage path.
Pipeline (OCR → extraction → embedding) runs in the background.
Subscribe to GET /documents/{id}/stream to receive the completion event.

get.description:
SSE endpoint — pushes exactly one event when the ingest pipeline finishes.

If the pipeline already completed before the client connected, responds
immediately from the DB (no Redis subscription needed).

Event payload:
  { status: "done" | "failed" | "timeout",
    doc_type, doc_type_confidence, summary, entity_count }
Poll pipeline status for a document.
